title: Alternating Extremes in Graceful Labelings of Full Binary Trees and Spider Trees
summary: We study a pinned form of graceful labeling. For full binary trees, we ask whether some deepest root-to-leaf path can carry the alternating extreme pattern $0,n-1,1,n-2,\dots$. Such a spine uses the extreme labels and largest differences, forcing all off-spine vertices and edges to use the middle labels and smaller differences, respectively.
